children: U.S. Federal Housing Director Bill Pulte highlighted the growing market share of VantageScore relative to FICO score in his X posts.
in a social media post that all mortgage-backed securities, credit risk transfers, and securitized products issued by Fannie Mae
will now carry a VantageScore in addition to a FICO score.
VantageScore is an independent joint venture company owned by Equifax (
the scoring solutions and services provider, Fair Isaac (
, as a monopoly and pushed for the use of VantageScore by lenders.
FICO is said to be used by 90% of lenders.

In his latest X post, Pulte said, "A small amount of biased people cast doubt that the market would welcome two (plus?) predictive credit scores, but per Bloomberg Terminal, the second score is strongly competing at 13% market share."
"Mortgage spreads are super tight. I expect the percentage to go higher and competition to go up."
"In another pool, VantageScore is at 59% market share while FICO is at 40% market share," he said separately. "Competition is good. Let them compete!"

title: FHFA's Pulte highlights growing market share of VantageScore in latest X posts
